verdict.rationale: Reducto's enterprise docs describe a dedicated VPC deployment and a hybrid VPC model in which all data and storage stay in the customer's VPC, and they separately claim air-gapped deployment options, which covers both halves of the story. These are short marketing-level statements, though, and the hybrid model still sends documents to Reducto's GPU infrastructure for processing. Missing for 10: detailed self-hosting/installation docs (infrastructure requirements, packaging, model hosting), clarity on which tiers get dedicated VPC or air-gapped access, and independent or hands-on corroboration of on-prem deployments.
